description: Lunera 1.8.3: startup and UI transition performance changes.

changelog.title: Startup and navigation
items: Startup intro follows elapsed display time without stretching missed frames
Inactive service creation waits until the intro finishes; active playback binds immediately
Short complete fades for tabs and settings pages
Glass capture reused during transition freezes while page content remains live

changelog.title: Player
items: Duration timer with optional Finish the song after the timer
Close cancels delayed resume work and clears both playback decks

changelog.title: Performance
items: Reuse unchanged queue metadata and reduce idle work
